# How to contribute

We welcome contributions to the unofficial Mekanism Fabric port for Minecraft 1.20.1.
Submit bug reports, feature requests, and pull requests to this repository. Target pull requests at `port/fabric-1.20.1`.

## Lang file contributions

Report translation issues and submit translation fixes for this Fabric port in this repository.

## Code contributions

Follow the existing Java formatting style: four-space indentation, wider column widths, and minimal forced wrapping.
IntelliJ IDEA users can import the [code style included in this repository](../docs/Mekanism.xml).
See [Development](../docs/Development.md) for the Fabric setup and build commands.
Keep changes focused and describe the validation performed in your pull request.
